title: DYFI Launches Youth Employment Survey
content: A regional survey to map employment needs and skill sets of coastal youth, covering Ullal, Mangaluru, Bantwal, and Belthangady.

title: Mangaluru Peace March Promotes Unity
content: Hundreds of youth joined the unity rally to build solidarity, peace, and mutual respect among different coastal communities.

title: District Volunteers Active in Coastal Cleanups
content: DYFI youth wings organized successful plastic cleanups and environmental awareness drives at popular coastal beaches in DK.

title: Bantwal Taluk Youth Sammelan Declares Action Plan
content: Over 500 delegates drafted community campaigns targeting education improvements, job security, and local civic issues.

title: Blood Donation Helpline Active in Coastal Hubs
content: DYFI volunteer desks processed over 250 blood requests during the hot summer months, saving vital emergency cases.

title: Student Admission Helpdesks Set up in Mangaluru
content: Helpdesks set up in city libraries and colleges to guide students through online admission procedures and college choices.
